title: getff maturity manifest (D32)
description: Single source of truth for maturity labels: sections layers (D4) and stacks (one row per installable positional). Every row = label + label definition + caveat + verified-at; stack rows add the rule-generation status. A row traces to an operator decision or a measurement (T-S0A-B) — an unknown fact is an operator question, never a placeholder (D36).

layers.description: D4 layer badges. Closed at rules + factory.

stacks.description: One row per installable positional (face-pages §5.1.4). Closed at the seven positionals `setup`/`install.sh` accept.

definition.description: What the label means. Identical in every row sharing the label (label↔definition is a function; principle 46 D32 arm).

verified-at.description: Date the row was last verified against the repo/operator record.

definition.description: What the label means. Identical in every row sharing the label (label↔definition is a function; principle 46 D32 arm).

caveat.description: The honest limit, one sentence (face-pages §5.1.4 column 4).

generation.description: Rule-doc generation status (face-pages §5.1.4 column 5): generated = rendered from the delivered rule set (rules-manifest render or install-time render); static = shipped hand-authored rule docs; deferred = no rule-doc generation shipped.

verified-at.description: Date the row was last verified against the repo/operator record.
